All of our lives were changed after this unbelievable experience. i just had one of the most insane animal interactions of my life, and by far the greatest rescue i've ever performed it's something i never could have expected, because i was just on a tour boat in waikiki hanging with these turtles when the captain angelina started flagging us back to the boat a solid 30 minutes before the tour was over i was confused but didn't want to disobey the captain so i swam back she told us that a whale shark was spotted nearby and was showing signs of distress having absolutely no idea what to expect, i got in the boat and we motored over to where all the comotion was i jumped in and before i could even start recording the whale shark was swimming directly towards me you really can't tell how big they are until you're in the water with them this thing could swallow me whole if it wanted to as it turned i noticed the reason it was coming up a huge derelict rope left by commercial fishing was wrapped around its body i had heard about this before, and that it is extremely dangerous to try to remove the big fish could suddenly pull you down and you would be lucky escape after only going deaf from barotrauma before i even had a chance to think i saw another diver appraoching with a knife out. he didn't think twice and just started cutting i thought it would be helpful if we took turns cutting so that the other could rest, so i offered to take the knife and try one would think that knife beats rope, but in this case it seemed like the rope was too think and the knife was barely doing anyting  i handed the knife back so that i could take a second to rest and the other diver could take his turn by this time it felt like there was a swarm of people all with knives ready to help this gentle giant i wanted to let the guys with knives do their thing and i would just film, but then i remembered i have my line cutting tool there were some smaller strands that i figured it could bust through and sure enough it took them both out in one pop each it gave me the idea to try it on the big rope and just take little sections at a time and something i didn't realize until this very moment is that there is such thing as too many people helping rescue a whale shark my friend olga was in the mix with her knife and at first i was like yeah no big deal then she stabbed me a little bit and i was like ok i don't want to go to the hospital after this so let's take turns so i kept hacking with my tool and taking breaks to let the other guys go it felt like we were making a ton of progress i might have been hacking a little too fast because i broke one of the guards off of the tool it's meant to cut a single strand of fishing line so i wasn't surprised i put it away because i wasn't sure how well it was working honestly everything was a blur as it was happening. if i didn't have the footage i would think it could have been a dream then one of the guys came up to me and told me that my tool was working better than the knives so i should keep going so i got it back out and kept hacking eventually the other guard broke off and it was basically just a razor blade with a handle i was so close to getting through that i thought i might as well just keep trying as i wittled it down smaller and smaller the whale finally took a small dive i was no longer able to breath with my snorkel and with all the kicking i was doing i couldn't hold my breath for very long i let one of the other guys work on it with his knife while i caught my breath one last time, preparing for the final stretch when he let go i knew it was my turn to do the final cuts i went down with what was left of my tool and the determination to free this bigge fishe it felt like it was slow motion when the two pieces finally came apart and we were able to remove the rope this line of torture and pain finally removed from the peaceful being it was such an indescribable feeling watching the other guys helping me pull the rope off. #5minuteplus
